purpose: Infrastructure-only replacement execution for the v231 Order 79 Writer hypothesis. The preserved v231 result used the legacy OpenAPA supervisor by mistake, failed before any model request or VM task execution, and is not evidence about the repair. This v232 run keeps the frozen v231 source behavior and task conditions but uses the LiteAgent parallel supervisor and runner required by the protocol. This prior-outcome-selected run is not a baseline denominator.
hypothesis: Both the v41 pass and v210 failure inspected the document first and observed next_reference_number 14. The v41 model selected 14, while v210 selected 12 because its actual strict request did not contain the dynamic marker or number enums: the existing constraint code was reachable only in the legacy tool-surface branch. After the wrong mutation consumed the marker, Qwen repeated the action and entered GUI/search loops. If strict mode requires document.inspect before this semantic action, applies the observed marker and next number to the actual model-visible schema, and recognizes a single numbered-reference request for proactive completion, Qwen will select the public action with unchanged constrained arguments, read back the result, terminate without GUI, and pass the original evaluator.
change_scope: No source change from v231. A focused writer_reference_semantics module recognizes only one bibliography/reference entry plus a numbered cross-reference at an explicit marker. A focused writer_reference_tooling module applies marker and next-reference-number enums from the latest public document.inspect result. Strict tool staging exposes document.inspect before the state-dependent mutation and uses the shared constraint helper for normal and recovery surfaces; the legacy branch reuses the same helper. instruction_semantics maps the reusable intent to document.add_numbered_reference so the existing strict completion state machine exposes read-back and then propose_done. No reference text, marker, number, task ID, answer, or model argument is parsed, created, replaced, or injected by the Runner.

sources.v210_outcome: Strict evidence-valid failure: reward 0.0, generic_api_plus_gui, 20 steps, no Agent termination, and agent_loop_time_budget_exhausted. The first mutation used model-selected number 12 despite document.inspect reporting next_reference_number 14; the actual second model request contained no enum constraint.
sources.historical_clean_pass_outcome: Reward 1.0 and current strict re-audit valid, evidence-valid, and baseline-admissible with zero model/action mismatch, rewrite, injection, or Adapter trace mismatch. The model selected number 14 but did not terminate and reached the 30-step cap with GUI fallback.
sources.v231_infrastructure_outcome: The legacy supervise_openapa_evaluation.py path selected run_openapa_pilot.py with gpt-5.6-sol defaults and failed twice on missing legacy config field openapa_commit. It emitted no model request and performed no VM task action. The immutable result is environment_failure and is excluded from the Writer hypothesis outcome.

implementation_evidence.counterfactuals: Three distinct single-reference paraphrases route to document.add_numbered_reference. Four negatives reject formatting, footnotes, plural references, and deletion. A structurally different synthetic document with marker <cite now>, six existing references, and next number 7 proves first-inspect staging, actual model-visible enums, exact unchanged execution arguments, inspect-only post-mutation exposure, and propose_done-only post-read-back exposure. A second document with next number 10 proves a stale model-selected 9 is rejected before Adapter execution.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 10 passed across Writer reference semantics, strict schema constraints, completion staging, and the existing Writer inspect constraint case
implementation_evidence.ruff: passed for active source, scripts, tests, and Adapters

selection.method: Infrastructure-only rerun of the same frozen v231 hypothesis after preserving the wrong-supervisor environment failure; no source, task, model, or protocol change
